scope: Vidora video understanding: YouTube audio ingestion, Groq transcription and generation, local embeddings, PostgreSQL storage, frontend disclosures, and supporting operations.
intended_use: Human-reviewed understanding of video content using summaries and source-based Q&A.
excluded_uses: Autonomous decisions affecting rights, access to services, or safety.
Claims of verified factual accuracy or validated global language coverage.
interested_parties: Speakers and people mentioned in videos
obligations: Identify applicable regional requirements before deployment.
Review authorized media use, data processing, provider responsibilities, and user notices.

controls.reference: Organizational policy (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Maintain a reviewed policy and management-system scope.

controls.reference: Ownership and escalation (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Assign accountable decision makers and a support intake process.

controls.reference: People and resources (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Document competence, staffing, and operational resources.

controls.reference: Impact assessment (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Assess effects on viewers, speakers, and people mentioned in recordings.

controls.reference: System lifecycle (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Review changes, evaluation evidence, release artifacts, and rollback.

controls.reference: Data management (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Review provenance, authorized processing, retention, and deletion evidence.

controls.reference: User information (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Disclose AI processing, limits, sources, expiry, and complaint options.

controls.reference: Intended use (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Define allowed uses, misuse scenarios, human review, and limitations.

controls.reference: Supplier relationships (project control; map to the licensed standard during review)
controls.rationale: Review Groq, hosting, database, models, and third-party responsibilities.

risks.description: Incorrect or unsupported answers may mislead viewers.
risks.treatment: Evaluate groundedness by language and show source excerpts.

risks.description: Audio and text may disclose personal data to external providers.
risks.treatment: Review processing locations, provider terms, privacy notices, and deletion evidence.

risks.description: Retrieval and transcription quality may vary by language and accent.
risks.treatment: Evaluate supported language and accent slices before approving deployment.

risks.description: Transcript instructions may influence generated output.
risks.treatment: Maintain adversarial evaluations and bounded model use; verify source-based answers.

risks.description: Model, provider, prompt, or retention changes may invalidate prior assessments.
risks.treatment: Bind release approval to policy, backend code, and retention configuration.

risks.description: User concerns may not reach a responsible reviewer.
risks.treatment: Establish an operator-owned report intake and test escalation and corrective actions.

objectives.description: Establish acceptable groundedness for each supported language before release.
objectives.metric: Reviewer-scored supported-answer proportion, worst supported language slice

objectives.description: Verify deletion of expired analysis data in the deployed environment.
objectives.metric: Proportion of sampled expired records deleted within the documented cleanup window

release.description: Initial AIMS adoption; reviews and evidence have not been supplied.
release.rollback_plan: Disable AI on all instances, assess impact, restore a reviewed build and matching policy/evidence package, then rerun release checks.
